results.name: open + text: hand-built PDF, three pages, page text in order
incremental save keeps the original bytes as an exact prefix; Prev chains to the old xref
page operations: reorder + delete + insert blank + move, verified by page text
annotations: 8 kinds written with appearance streams; PDF text of the FreeText comes back from its appearance
forms: text field + checkbox + choice filled, appearances generated, values re-read
NEG forms: read-only field and unknown field are refused, document unchanged
NEG page ops: deleting every page, bad permutations and out-of-range rotate throw
privacy: a clean copy drops a deleted page's content; the incremental save keeps it (documented)
merge + extract: page counts and text order
NEG damaged xref: save() falls back to a clean rewrite instead of chaining onto bad offsets
NEG hostile input: garbage, truncation, page-tree loop and absurd /Count stay bounded
names round-trip byte-exactly (GBK font name bytes survive a rewrite) — regression
synthesised appearances for annotations without /AP (as PDFium/Acrobat); NEG: no colour → nothing
NEG shading: an axial shading whose function takes 18 inputs is rejected (PDFium paints nothing)
text fitting: wrap() never exceeds the width; Helvetica widths match the AFM ("Hello" = 2.278 em at 1 pt)
routing: .pdf opens in the PDF app; forge grade A with the gaps written into the boundary
encrypted files: RC4/AES open with their pdf.js-manifest passwords; edits stay encrypted and re-open; NEG wrong password
corpus: 972 pdf.js test files open; page tree agrees with PDFium/pypdf page counts (/tmp/struct.jsonl)
oracle: our edits re-opened by PDFium + qpdf (rotate, annotate, title, reorder/delete/insert, merge, extract)
oracle: text differential vs PDFium ≥ 0.93 mean bigram-F1 (needs /tmp/text.jsonl)
interpreter: annotations of every corpus page run without throwing (bounded time)
CCITT tables: white/black/mode codes are prefix-free and complete (Kraft sum), as T.4 requires
CCITT oracle: libtiff (via Pillow) encodes 9 bitmaps as G4, G3-1D and G3-2D; our decoder reproduces every bit
NEG CCITT: corrupt, truncated and garbage streams decode the good rows, flag partial, never throw or hang; absurd sizes are capped
CCITT in a page: an inline /CCF image reaches the device as decoded 1-bit samples (no 'unsupported codec')
CID-keyed CFF: an explicit top FontMatrix is not scaled again (issue16500 glyphs at 1000-unit size, not ×1000) — regression
nested content keeps the caller's graphics state: unbalanced q/Q in a form/glyph never unwinds the page's q levels — regression
embedded-file-only encryption (/EFF, StmF+StrF Identity) opens without a password like PDFium — regression
